events.title: North Korea tells EU to 'mind its own business' on human rights
events.description: North Korea's UN mission has lashed out at the European Union over a draft UN resolution. Pyongyang has said the West does not have a monopoly on human rights.

events.title: Poland arrests 4 accused of spying for Russia
events.description: Poland has charged four people with espionage, saying they were sending information to Moscow. Two more have been accused of shipping military components to Russia.

events.title: Israel's Arab list backs Eisenkot as Netanyahu loses ultra-Orthodox support
events.description: Israel's largest Arab party grouping said Thursday it would recommend opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to form the next government, potentially bolstering his bid after Arab-majority lists won a record 19 seats in last week's election and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu lost the support of an allied religious party.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Israel's Arab list backs Eisenkot as Netanyahu loses ultra-Orthodox support

events.title: Bringing the magic of Harry Potter to life through music
events.description: In this edition of Entre Nous, we meet Timothy Henty, the British conductor bringing the magic of Harry Potter to life in Paris. As part of the Harry Potter Film Concert Series, he leads more than 80 musicians in a spectacular live orchestral performance, offering audiences a unique opportunity to experience one of cinema's most beloved stories like never before.

events.title: British comedian Russell Brand found guilty of rape, sexual assault
